title: Implement Stage 2 actor service observations
summary: Add behavior-neutral versioned actor service records and bounded epoch aggregation while preserving the legacy shard drain and deferring every forceable Stage 2 policy.
planned_changes: Define independent disabled and observe-only actor-service and buffer-copy connection configuration; add versioned immutable observations and fixed-field epoch accumulators; capture existing actor queue, service, wake, work-kind, effect, follow-on, lifecycle, skip, and fault primitives; capture current send-side retry, raw queue, formatting, combination, and sent-retention copy primitives; keep missing runnable, oldest-item, deadline-lateness, work-unit, terminal-release, retained-age, and pool-outstanding state explicit; add machine-readable schemas and semantic validation; test sink neutrality, sequence, aggregation, reset, ownership, and existing shard correctness; then design an exact post-service export boundary and remaining copy paths before permanent campaign emission.
verification_plan: Build in Release before testing. Run REQ-QUIC-CRT-0181, REQ-QUIC-CRT-0182, existing shard, deadline, work-item layout, application-send queue, receive-buffer ownership, stream-capacity, flow-control, metrics, cancellation, disposal, retransmission, and terminal tests. Validate actor and buffer observation and epoch schemas plus semantic count, sequence, legacy-identity, capacity, and join rules. Run manual or nightly cost and allocation checks outside correctness CI before enabling permanent high-volume export. Do not force actor_work_quantum or buffer_copy_coalescing or claim fairness or performance improvement.
out_of_scope: Large campaign execution, dataset normalization, or ML analysis
